item.title: Moo You Bloody Choir – Augie March 20th Anniversary Tour
item.description: Ed Ammendola, founding member of the iconic local band Augie March, talks to Craig Francis about the history of the band and making it big locally and overseas. Ed also discusses the band’s upcoming Melbourne tour dates celebrating the 20th anniversary of ‘Moo, You Bloody Choir’, the true meaning behind ‘One Crowded Hour’, and the release of their new album.Related
